caption: The drawing depicts a single glass inkwell positioned centrally against a plain beige background. The inkwell is rendered in shades of green and exhibits a transparent glass quality, with highlights and reflections accurately illustrating its surface and thickness. The object has a wide, flared base that narrows near the middle before expanding into a short neck, topped with a flat, round lid or stopper. The lines and curves of the inkwell are clearly defined, and the shading indicates light reflecting off the glass. There is a faint rectangular outline bordering the central composition, and the artist's signature, "John Tarentino," is placed in small text in the lower right corner within the border.
title: Inkwell
